title: Visual oracle failures: 58-70% pixel mismatch Canvas vs Ruffle (SWF fidelity gap)
description:
The visual-oracle E2E tests (apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts) run end-to-end but all 3 fixtures fail with 58-70% pixel difference. The 20% threshold is never met.

DIAGNOSED ROOT CAUSES (2026-06-09):

[HARNESS BUG 1 - PRIMARY] DPR mismatch: StageArea renders at canvas.width = stageW * devicePixelRatio (e.g. 1100x800 on a 2x display). Playwright's element.screenshot() on the <canvas> captures physical pixels, giving a 1100x800 PNG. The Ruffle player is CSS-sized at 550x400 so its screenshot is 550x400. The compareScreenshots helper does a naive resize before pixelmatch, but misalignment from 2x->1x downscale causes ~40-50% of mismatches. Fix: use playwright config deviceScaleFactor:1 for visual-oracle tests, OR add a __flashTest.screenshotStage() bridge that renders to a 1:1 offscreen canvas and returns PNG bytes.

[HARNESS BUG 2 - PRIMARY] Off-screen Ruffle player: captureRuffleScreenshot injects the player at top:-9999px;left:-9999px. Playwright may produce a blank or mis-composited capture for off-screen elements. Fix: use visibility:hidden; position:fixed; top:0; left:0 instead, so the element is in the render tree.

[HARNESS BUG 3] Wrong canvas selector: captureStageScreenshot uses page.locator('canvas').first() which may grab the grid overlay canvas instead of the render canvas. Fix: add data-testid='stage-canvas' to the renderCanvasRef element in StageArea.tsx and target that selector.

[SWF BUG - SECONDARY] Shape paths encode absolute coordinates into DefineShape4, then PlaceObject2 adds obj.x/obj.y as additional translation. The canonical SWF convention is to normalize shape paths to origin (0,0 bounding box) and put the full offset in PlaceObject2. This may cause Ruffle clipping issues. Fix in packages/swf/src/shapes.ts: subtract bounds.xMin/yMin from all path coordinates in encodeDefineShape4, and confirm PlaceObject2 tx/ty accounts for the normalization.

Acceptance criteria:
- Fix harness bugs 1-3 first; re-run to see true rendering delta.
- All 3 visual-oracle fixtures pass at <= 5% pixel mismatch.
- Add at least one passing fixture to prevent regression.
- Do not simply raise the threshold.

Key files:
- apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts (harness fixes)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx (add data-testid, DPR-1 screenshot bridge)
- packages/swf/src/shapes.ts encodeDefineShape4 (shape origin normalization)
- packages/swf/src/compile.ts (PlaceObject2 tx/ty)
